source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
With **DRUKHARI** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), you can Empower your units that carry Pain abilities by paying Pain tokens. Every **DRUKHARI** unit has a Pain ability, which applies to it only while it is Empowered.

You gain 1 Pain token:

- as [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins
- whenever one of your opponent's units is **destroyed**
- whenever one of your opponent's units fails its [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)

The tokens you collect form your Pain token pool, and each token you pay leaves it. Each Pain ability says when you can pay tokens to Empower its unit. That unit is then Empowered, and every Pain ability it has applies, for the rest of the phase. An Empowered **Attached unit** applies the Pain abilities of every Leader and Bodyguard unit in it, with no extra tokens to pay for them.

Enhancements, Stratagems and some other rules can also use Pain tokens for extra effects.
